help.title: How can we help?
help.subtitle: Quick answers or open a support ticket.
help.q1Answer: Orders are usually shipped within 1–2 business days. Delivery times depend on your region in Italy.
help.q2Answer: You can request a return within 14 days for unused items in original packaging. See our returns policy page for details.
help.q3Question: How do I track my order?
help.q3Answer: After shipping you will receive an email with tracking information. You can also check order status in your account.
help.q4Answer: Many products support logo customization. On the product page, enable customization and upload your logo before adding to cart.
help.q5Answer: Use the Tickets section in the menu to create a ticket. Our team will reply in the same thread.

adminProducts.importHint: Export downloads all products (one row per size/color). Use the template or edit an export and re-import new products. After you choose a file, pick one CSV column, then select which values in that column to import (e.g. Merceologica or Categoria for supplier lists). Supplier columns Codice Padre, SKU, Descrizione, Foto, Prezzo Unico are supported.
